pages.text_en: Warning! The sea level is rising. The world will flood! This is a disaster! We must build shelters immediately. The news was terrible. The ice was melting fast. I will build a tower on sturdy pillars. I will build a raft. It will float on the waves! They had to work quickly to save themselves.

sentences.zh: 我们必须立即建造避难所。

sentences.text_en: I will build a tower on sturdy pillars.
sentences.zh: 我要在坚固的柱子上建一座塔。

sentences.text_en: It will float on the waves!
They had to work quickly to save themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们必须迅速行动来拯救自己。

pages.text_en: These titanium pillars will never rust! They are indestructible! JJ drilled deep into the ground! Mikey finished his simple raft! My house is light! It will bob like a cork!

sentences.text_en: These titanium pillars will never rust!
sentences.zh: 这些钛合金柱子永远不会生锈！

sentences.text_en: JJ drilled deep into the ground!

sentences.zh: Mikey 造好了他的简易木筏！

sentences.text_en: It will bob like a cork!
sentences.zh: 它会像软木塞一样上下漂浮！

pages.text_en: Suddenly, the ocean swallowed the land! Here it comes! Hold on tight! My tower is safe and dry! Whew! My raft is floating perfectly!

sentences.text_en: Suddenly, the ocean swallowed the land!
My tower is safe and dry!

pages.text_en: JJ had a clever machine for survival! This filters the salt! Now I have fresh drinking water! Mikey found food in the sea! I caught a huge fish! I will not go hungry!

sentences.text_en: JJ had a clever machine for survival!
sentences.zh: JJ 有一个聪明的求生机器！

sentences.text_en: Now I have fresh drinking water!
sentences.zh: 现在我有干净的饮用水了！

sentences.text_en: Mikey found food in the sea!
sentences.zh: Mikey 在海里找到了食物！

pages.text_en: Hey! Get away! That is my dinner! The birds stole everything and flew away! No! My food!

sentences.text_en: The birds stole everything and flew away!
sentences.zh: 鸟儿们偷走了所有东西，飞走了！

pages.text_en: A storm began to howl across the ocean! Get inside, Mikey! The weather is turning bad! I feel terrible! The waves are too strong!

sentences.text_en: A storm began to howl across the ocean!
sentences.zh: 一场风暴开始在海上呼啸！

pages.text_en: Something enormous was lurking below! Mikey, look at the water! Help me! It's going to eat the raft!

sentences.zh: 有什么巨大的东西潜伏在下面！

sentences.text_en: It's going to eat the raft!

pages.text_en: My shelter is destroyed! JJ activated his secret weapon! Take this, you beast! Electric shock!

sentences.zh: JJ 启动了他的秘密武器！

pages.text_en: The shark was stunned and swam away fast! Climb up, Mikey! Hurry before it comes back!

sentences.text_en: The shark was stunned and swam away fast!
sentences.zh: 鲨鱼被电晕，飞快地游走了！

pages.text_en: You saved my life, JJ! Your house is amazing! We survived the water world!

sentences.zh: 我们在水世界里活了下来！
